elaine: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 shows the generate endpoint examples with max_new_tokens as "100" (string) in the curl snippet and the request body uses "input" as an array instead of the canonical "messages" object. This is causing the JS snippet tests to fail.

sam: Ugh, saw the failing docs-tests this morning. Thanks for flagging. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

marta: I can take a pass on this today. Which examples are impacted — curl, python, and SDK snippets?

sam: All three. The offending curl block is:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","max_new_tokens":"100","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}'
```
It should be:
```
{"model":"redwood-v1","max_new_tokens":100,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}
```
Numbers not strings, and use messages key.

elaine: Also, the streaming SSE sample in that doc emits events with `role: assistant` but the schema for chat-stream expects a top-level `type` and `delta` fields. Tests assume the /chat streaming format — we should align the generate streaming example to the same contract or explicitly call out differences.

tyler: I can push a tiny patch: convert max_new_tokens -> numeric, rename input->messages, and update the python snippet to use messages=[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]. Will append a short note in the PR description explaining why this is breaking snippet linting.

marta: Please also add a short CHANGELOG entry under docs/changes.md and mention the snippet test id. I'll run the docs-test locally after your change.

docs-bot: build-docs #1234 started for branch fix/reqshape-examples (triggered by tyler)

sam: One more: the OpenAPI example in api-ref/generate.yaml shows timeout_ms as required in the example but the schema marks it nullable/optional. I bumped into that while reconciling examples. Leave a TODO comment in the PR so we can decide default behavior.

elaine: Good catch — that explains why some snippet runners pass locally and fail in CI. Can someone add a small OpenAPI example normalization step (or just change the example to omit timeout_ms)?

tyler: Patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcd1234 — replaced strings with numbers, input->messages, adjusted python + curl + node snippets. Left a TODO in generate.yaml about timeout_ms nullability.

marta: Ran docs-test locally against that commit. All snippet tests pass now, plus I added a test to assert numeric token fields are numbers. PR updated, description includes CHANGELOG note.

sam: Thanks. I'll add a quick unit in the snippet linter to catch quoted numbers in JSON bodies.

tyler: Merged PR, :shipit:

docs-bot: build-docs #1234 succeeded for branch fix/reqshape-examples

sam: CI green. If anything else pops up about sample shapes, ping me in #docs. Closing thread.
